summary: 15 Java files implementing all 51 LRE requirements; build clean; result_codegen.json covers every requirement and cites every file. Five review items: one requirement conflict, two invented defaults, two design choices.

issues.title: LRE-DM5 and LRE-OP5 disagree on the no-obstacle default for relative position accessors
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 makes nsRelDist/ewRelDist return zero when no obstacle exists; LRE-OP5 says the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults'. A CPA built from zero relative position gives cda=0 and would spuriously fire MOM->CAM whenever no dynamic obstacle exists.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the intended no-obstacle default for nsRelDist/ewRelDist, or state that cda must be derived from hdist. Resolved here by keeping DM5 literal and computing cda = sqrt(hdist^2 - (r.v)^2/|v|^2), which yields the safe large distance when the obstacle is absent.

issues.title: Magnitude of the 'safe large distance' is unspecified
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires odist/hdist/vdist to return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists but gives no value.
issues.fix_directive: Replace Sensor.SAFE_LARGE_DIST (currently 1000.0 m) with the operational sensor range if one is defined.

issues.title: Division guard in the CPA computation
issues.raw: CalcCPA.EPSILON = 1.0E-9 keeps the relative-speed denominator positive; the codegen rules forbid locals, ternaries and conditionals in compute(), so no explicit zero test was available.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the degenerate-case semantics: with zero relative velocity the implementation gives tcpa = 0 and cda = hdist(cdyn).

issues.title: Relative velocity subtracts the AUV's own velocity
issues.raw: LRE-DM2 defines obs_ns_vel/obs_ew_vel as the obstacle's velocity while LRE-OP5 speaks of 'relative position and velocity'. CalcCPA uses obsNsVel(cdyn) - nsVel().
issues.fix_directive: State whether the obstacle velocity fields are absolute or already AUV-relative; if relative, drop the subtraction.

issues.title: CAM has no entry action
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says CAM performs evasive manoeuvres but LRE-DM7 limits outputs to advVel/advHdng and no requirement gives a concrete evasive value.
issues.fix_directive: Supply the advised velocity and/or heading for CAM, or confirm that CAM issues no output. MOM and HCM do carry the entry actions LRE-FR2 and LRE-FR3 specify.
